# Review

Within [environment quality](../README.md), environment review gives the documentation and code that make up an environment an independent inspection. A reviewer with no inherited authoring conversation or project conclusions inspects what the combined surface causes participants to understand, do, and observe, including results that actual execution permits or produces.

Review separates the author's orchestration from the reviewer's inspection so that independence holds across handoffs, evaluation, and repair. Supplying intent, conditions, and causal context without private explanations or repair conclusions keeps the resulting report usable as unsteered evidence.

## Workflow

[Review workflow](workflow.md) guides the author through deciding when review adds evidence, preparing the handoff, evaluating findings, and arranging re-reviews.

## Protocol

[Review protocol](protocol.md) tells the reviewer how to inspect an environmental surface and report every supported problem without proposing repairs.
